newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.

text.p: Grain and soybean FOB values were mostly steady on Friday in very quiet dealings after Thursday's Thanksgiving Day holiday, export sources said.
"It was extremely quiet here," one source said. "I think we're all going home."
Brokers noted talk that Iraq will likely shun the United States when it begins buying wheat with proceeds from its pending oil sales.
Turkey, which hopes to supply most of the wheat to Iraq under the U.N. oil-for-food deal, said on Friday Iraq oil should start flowing December 15.
Iraq was expected to import wheat worth $306 million under the deal, Turkish officials said.
